scripts.build: npm run native:build && npm run plugin:build
scripts.check: npm run consistency:check && npm run locales:check && npm run chrome:check && npm run chrome:store:check && npm run test:unit && npm run typecheck && npm run build && node scripts/check-package.mjs && npm run marketplace:check
scripts.pack: npm run check && npm run dependencies:check && npm run test:native && npm run validate && npm run marketplace:release:check && streamdeck pack ./dev.n7s.media-controls.sdPlugin --force

scripts.test:native: cargo test --locked --manifest-path native/media-info/Cargo.toml && cargo test --locked --manifest-path native/media-keys/Cargo.toml
scripts.marketplace:release:check: npm run marketplace:check && node scripts/check-release.mjs marketplace
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run dependencies:check && npm run test:native && npm run test:chrome:e2e && npm run validate && npm run release:status
scripts.pack:review: npm run check && npm run validate && streamdeck pack ./dev.n7s.media-controls.sdPlugin --force
